issues.title: Close remaining header/hero visual gap
issues.details: Target-vs-current comparisons still show differences in compactness, panel composition, and controls.

issues.title: Replace procedural interval artwork with researched scenes
issues.details: 172 intervals have direct assignments but many are variations from shared themes.
issues.acceptance: Flagship scenes separately commissioned/generated and reviewed for period plausibility.

issues.title: Schematic depth is not calibrated 3D
issues.details: Depth cue estimates are illustrative; no registered anatomical coordinate model.
issues.acceptance: Retain schematic labeling or adopt verified registered model with provenance.

issues.title: More tradition-specific hero portraits
issues.details: 363 entries have art coverage, but most are symbolic.
issues.acceptance: Featured hero/thumbnail set reviewed by subject and tradition.

issues.title: Separate related figures from linked historical artwork
issues.details: Related-figure navigation exists; licensed artwork carousel is a separate unbuilt workflow.
issues.acceptance: Display source, attribution, license and related art separately.

issues.title: Test folder sync and persistence on Windows
issues.details: File System Access, IndexedDB, and local persistent settings need actual Windows Edge/Chrome tests.
issues.acceptance: Successful re-open with synced HTML, dataset, and local artwork.

issues.title: Review 57 documented scientific ambiguities
issues.details: Immutable v1.0 dataset published with scientific warnings; changes require a new dataset release.
issues.acceptance: Ambiguities resolved or explicitly carried into next version with sources.

issues.title: Connect artwork review approvals to release rebuilds
issues.details: Review records do not automatically update production manifests or HTML.
issues.acceptance: Build manifest diff and checksum reconciliation before release.

issues.title: Extend illustrated atlas styling beyond first three
issues.details: Tree of Life has shared headers; main-stage visual richness remains behind the concept direction.
issues.acceptance: Approved subject-appropriate reference composition and screenshot comparison.

issues.title: Improve anatomy-stage clarity and visual depth
issues.details: Keep muscle map and exercises functional while upgrading selected muscle focus.
issues.acceptance: Enhanced visual with exercise mapping preserved.

issues.title: Improve interactive level diagrams and evidence panels
issues.details: Broaden visual clarity without implying unsupported quantitative certainty.
issues.acceptance: Each active level shows a tested relation/evidence panel.

issues.title: Resolve historical checklist summary mismatch
issues.details: Previous summary was 28/30/26; row-based count is 27/30/27.
issues.acceptance: Counts generated directly from 84 item statuses with no manual override.

suggestions.title: Turn the interval hero into a cohesive editorial scene
suggestions.detail: Rebalance scene, title, tabs and supporting facts; keep period art and existing five-topic data.

suggestions.title: Make representative-life cards into a richer specimen browser
suggestions.detail: Expand cards to real linked taxa and verified source previews, not mockup species or invented counts.

suggestions.title: Improve brain centerpiece and selected-region emphasis
suggestions.detail: Keep schematic projection but refine shading, layering and selected-region focus.

suggestions.title: Persistent selected-region facts panel
suggestions.detail: Show function, evolution, clinical implications and transmitters using existing detail records.

suggestions.title: Cinematic profile and richer right-side relationships
suggestions.detail: Emphasize artwork with readable overlays; preserve original genealogy.

suggestions.title: Licensed related-artwork gallery
suggestions.detail: Separate actual historical artwork with credits, external links and rights metadata from generated portraits.

suggestions.title: Illustrated clade/organism focus stage
suggestions.detail: Preserve taxonomy hierarchy and show sourced organism imagery for selected taxa.

suggestions.title: Muscle region render and compact exercise panel
suggestions.detail: Enhance muscle illustration with primary/secondary exercise attribution.

suggestions.title: Interactive emergence-layer network comparison
suggestions.detail: Show comparative scales and explanatory caveats by selected level.

suggestions.title: Dependency and readiness visualization
suggestions.detail: Use real sync, linked files and dataset import status; never hard-code mockup 248MB counts.

suggestions.title: One-click art-promotion staging with provenance
suggestions.detail: Review → license check → manifest diff → build; artwork not promoted just from a status change.

qa.tested: Browser interaction smoke tests; Windows source syncing and persistence not confirmed

notes.goals: Source v1.17 Goal Tracker has 27 implemented / 30 partial / 27 planned when counted from 84 records.
